run_fileIOPlugin: run the pybullet fileIOPlugin example to load nested zip files and render an SDF robot model in GUI mode
loadPlugin_fileIOPlugin: load the fileIOPlugin in pybullet to enable zip file I/O actions for nested archive extraction
executePluginCommand_zip: execute a plugin command to add a zip file I/O action for extracting nested zip archives in pybullet
loadSDF_model: load an SDF robot model file from an extracted zip archive using pybullet loadSDF
changeVisualShape_rgba: change the visual shape RGBA color of a loaded pybullet body link
